segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making the time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the quote changes and make sure the seat count and start date line up before I send it to deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We confirmed 38 standard users and 6 admin users. The admins are mostly managers, so they’ll need the approval workflow and reporting access.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So 44 total seats, with 6 on the admin tier. I have the target go-live as October 14, with onboarding starting September 23. Does that still work on your side?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, as long as we can get the data import template by the 16th. Our ops analyst is out the week after, so I don’t want that to slip.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. I’ll have customer success send the template right after signature, and I’ll note the September 16 target in the handoff. On pricing, the updated annual total is $41,280 before tax, billed annually.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the implementation fee we discussed?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: The $3,500 implementation fee is listed as a one-time line item. So year one is $44,780 before tax, and the renewal would just be the subscription unless you add seats or services.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I have. On contract terms, procurement asked if we can do a 30-day payment term instead of due on receipt.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 30 is fine. I’ll update the order form and run it through the billing tool. Anything else procurement flagged?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just the auto-renewal notice. They want 60 days’ notice, not 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can do 60 days. I’ll send the revised order form by end of day. If you can return it by Friday, we’ll hold the September 23 onboarding slot.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it over, and I’ll route it for signature this afternoon.
